description: This file defines the SecurityNotAllowedMethodError class, which is an exception used within Twig's sandbox security system. The class is thrown when a disallowed method is invoked in a template, capturing details about the class and method involved.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedMethodError
classes.description: Exception thrown when a not allowed class method is used in a template. It extends SecurityError and stores the class and method names involved in the security violation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message, class name, and method name.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class involved in the security error.

methods.name: getMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method involved in the security error.
